reason: A file utility plugin for rule-based batch renaming with dry-run preview and confirmed filesystem changes.

summaries.zh: 按查找替换、前后缀和大小写规则批量重命名文件，并支持执行前预览。
summaries.en: Batch-renames files using search-and-replace, prefix, suffix, and case rules with a dry-run preview before execution.

capabilities: Reads files and directory entries under a specified root
